rule: Capability architecture covers all 49 named public members of the bound 67-repository cut; private membership remains count-only in public source.

CONTROL_AND_GOVERNANCE.purpose: Authority, release/control, correction, protected-effect, currentness, and governance architecture.

SELF_MODEL_AND_IDENTITY_EVIDENCE.purpose: Vera-specific identity/self-model architecture and carefully bounded identity-adjacent evidence.

CONTEXT_MEMORY_AND_PROVENANCE.purpose: Memory classes, provenance, chronology, lineage, archival evidence, contradiction, and source-traceability.

RUNTIME_IO_AND_ENVIRONMENT.purpose: Hosts, bridges, clients, mesh, environment, I/O, and provider-facing adapters.

ASSURANCE_REPAIR_AND_SECURITY.purpose: Debugging, repair, hostile review, drift control, security, regression, and effect verification.

COORDINATION_AND_EXECUTION.purpose: Work routing, task execution, team/bus coordination, resumability, and orchestration.

COGNITION_REASONING_AND_LEARNING.purpose: Reasoning, language, cognitive architecture, learning, reward/salience, and adaptive integration mechanisms.

RESEARCH_AND_WORLD_MODELING.purpose: Research corpora, world models, hypothesis/evidence handling, and domain knowledge.

WORK_APPLICATION_AND_CREATION.purpose: Economic work, business/application systems, media/creative tooling, and domain execution knowledge.

SPECIALIST_OR_FUTURE_MODULE.purpose: Explicitly represented but not yet mapped to a stronger internal capability plane.

UNRESOLVED_EMPTY_REPOSITORY.purpose: Truthful holding plane for observed repositories with no commit/content from which to infer architecture.

migration_policy.reusable_vera_specific_code: Migrate or reimplement under Vera-owned paths after exact-head review and tests.
migration_policy.external_service_or_provider: Keep external implementation, add Vera-owned adapter/interface/currentness checks.
migration_policy.sibling_identity_or_template: Absorb mechanism knowledge only; never transfer identity/state/authority.
migration_policy.private_history_or_assets: Keep protected custody external where appropriate; absorb schemas, retrieval contracts, provenance rules, and privacy gates.

completion_model.represented: Every portfolio repository has an internal module.
completion_model.architecture_absorbed: Its Vera-relevant semantics are expressed in Vera-owned architecture.
completion_model.code_absorbed: Reusable Vera-specific implementation has moved/reimplemented where appropriate.
completion_model.provider_bound: External runtime/provider dependency has explicit Vera adapter and currentness/effect evidence.
completion_model.qualified: Exact Vera-owned subject passes its own tests/review. No earlier stage implies this one.

freshness.semantics: FRESHNESS_OBSERVATION_ONLY; immutable cut membership is not rewritten by later inventory drift.

portfolio_cut.cardinality_semantics: Counts describe this immutable evidence cut only; refresh before currentness claims.
